name: TRON DAO
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: TRON DAO stated on X that its account was compromised on May 2, 2025, at 9:25 AM PST. During the breach, an unauthorized party published a post containing contract address, sent private messages, and followed several unknown accounts.
